inputs: 02_analytics/torque_speed_envelope.py (constants, T03 design; T03 JSON not modified)

vehicle_requirements.note: motor torque = value / G; motor speed = wheel rpm x G

meta.objective: max P at 90 km/h subject to 12 % start torque and rotor tip speed; gear ratio free
notes: Fixed-pole machines use SPB coil-phase feeding (k_d = 1): at least as good as a 3-phase belt winding.
N_leg is continuous (effective series turns per leg); integer rounding = small change of stack/turn choice.

2p=6 is not realisable on 48 slots with 16 three-phase modules (p divisible by 3 puts a module's 3 coils in phase). It needs Q=144 with 3 coils in series per leg (coils 120 deg mech apart, same phase).
Efficiency is machine only (no inverter, no gearbox).

pole_changing_2p8_4_gear_optimised.note: Same T03 machine, gear ratio chosen by the same rule as the fixed-pole baselines

fixed_2p4.note: rows = speed, columns = torque (motor side); loss includes friction/windage; NaN = outside envelope

fixed_2p6.note: rows = speed, columns = torque (motor side); loss includes friction/windage; NaN = outside envelope

pole_changing_2p8_4_T03.note: rows = speed, columns = torque (motor side); loss includes friction/windage; NaN = outside envelope

realistic_loss_model.stray_load: IEC 60034-2-1 assumed allowance P_LL,N = P1,N (0.025 - 0.005 log10(P2,N/1 kW)), scaled (T/T_N)^2; T_N = P_rated / omega_base of the active mode; sensitivity x2
realistic_loss_model.rotor_skin: deep rectangular bar, h_bar = 25 mm x (R/165 mm), k_R(xi) on the bar part of R_r at slip frequency and at f_sw; ring x5 at f_sw
realistic_loss_model.magnetising_copper: included in |I_s|; magnetising share 48 I_m^2 R_s reported

pwm.ripple: dI_pp = V_mod/(4 L_hf f_sw), L_hf = 0.5 (L_s,sigma + L_r,sigma), triangular rms
pwm.tooth_eddy: Bertotti eddy term at f_sw with lamination skin correction, mu_r = 1000

realistic_loss_model.flux_strategies: flux_optimised = loss-minimising flux; rated_flux = highest feasible flux (cap or voltage-limited)
excluded: gearbox losses (eta_gear = 0.97 constant, independent of ratio)

two_speed_gearbox.note: G_low just meets the 12 % start; G_high maximises P at 90 km/h (tip-speed limited)
